让每一步计算，都清晰可见。: See every step of your calculation.
编写公式，填入参数，实时查看结果与执行过程。: Write a formula, enter parameters, and explore results and execution steps in real time.
Formula Calc · 浏览器本地计算，输入保存在当前浏览器: Formula Calc · Calculated locally; inputs saved in this browser
Formula Calc 在线公式调试：参数、批量计算、精度设置与逐步执行日志。: Formula Calc playground: parameters, batch calculations, precision settings and execution logs.
对象计算一次，对象数组逐组计算。保留原始结构及值类型。: An object runs once; an array of objects runs as a batch. Structure and value types are preserved.
当前公式没有参数；输入变量后会自动生成列表。: No parameters yet. Enter variables to generate the list.
动态缺失参数返回 null: Return null for dynamically missing parameters
默认保留字面值与参数精度，可关闭对应开关。缺参预检查仍会等待补齐参数。: Literals and parameters keep their precision by default. Turn off the corresponding switches to round them. Missing parameters still need to be supplied.
修正输入后将自动计算。: Calculates automatically after you fix the input.
参数数组为空，没有需要计算的数据。: The parameter array is empty. There is nothing to calculate.
点击定位原始表达式: Click to locate the original expression
计算执行后会显示实际经过的节点；未执行的条件分支不会出现在日志中。: The log shows only executed nodes. Conditional branches that were not executed are omitted.
输入函数或参数名称自动补全 · Ctrl+Space 显示候选 · $n 引用普: Type a function or parameter to autocomplete · Ctrl+Space shows suggestions · $n references grouping parentheses
参数 JSON 必须是对象，或由对象组成的数组。: Parameter JSON must be an object or an array of objects.
请输入 JSON 数组或对象: Enter a JSON array or object
精度必须是 0 到 100 的整数: Precision must be an integer from 0 to 100
按指定小数位舍入: Round to the specified decimal places
根据条件选择结果: Choose a result based on a condition
限制数值范围: Clamp a value to a range
检查属性是否存在及其类型: Check whether a property exists and its type
返回参数值，函数调用括号不产生引用: Return the argument; function call parentheses do not create references
平方和的平方根: Square root of the sum of squares
支持 + - * / // % ^、比较、条件表达式和内置函数。2.01% 是百: Supports + - * / // % ^, comparisons, conditional expressions and built-in functions. 2.01% is a percentage; a % b is modulo. Use double quotes for strings and single quotes for parameter names containing spaces.
普通括号从左到右编号，$1 引用第一个括号的结果。函数调用括号不编号。相同颜色表: Grouping parentheses are numbered from left to right. $1 references the first group. Function call parentheses are not numbered. Matching colors show references; type $ to choose a valid reference.
JSON 顶层对象计算一次，对象数组逐组计算；嵌套数组可以作为 sum(valu: A top-level JSON object runs once; an array of objects runs as a batch. Nested arrays can be passed to sum(values). JSON mode uses library paths such as user.discount. Parameters inside dynamic eval strings are not discovered automatically.
表单数字使用 Decimal 保留输入精度。JSON 数字遵循 JavaScri: Form numbers use Decimal to preserve precision. JSON numbers follow JavaScript JSON.parse; use strings for very long numbers and enable “Convert numeric strings to numbers”.
全局 stepPrecision 控制步骤舍入，自定义函数可配置 useStep: Global stepPrecision controls step rounding. Custom functions can set useStepPrecision: false. arithmetic controls numeric handling independently of step rounding.
计算余弦，参数为弧度: Cosine of an angle in radians
计算正弦，参数为弧度: Sine of an angle in radians
计算正切，参数为弧度: Tangent of an angle in radians
截去小数部分，向 0 取整: Remove the fractional part; truncate toward zero
转换为字符串，空值转换为空字符串: Convert to a string; null becomes an empty string
减法；支持负数字面值: Subtraction; negative numeric literals are supported
整除，截去商的小数部分: Integer division; truncate the quotient toward zero
取余，与百分比后缀不同: Modulo, distinct from the percentage suffix
相等；按库的数值处理及字符串比较规则判断: Equality, using library numeric handling and string comparison rules
逻辑与，左侧为假时短路并返回左侧值: Logical AND; returns the left value when falsy without evaluating the right
逻辑或，左侧为真时短路并返回左侧值: Logical OR; returns the left value when truthy without evaluating the right
条件为真返回 then，否则返回 else；只计算选中的分支: Return then if the condition is true, otherwise else; only the selected branch is evaluated
括号分组，改变计算顺序；普通括号可以被 $n 引用: Group expressions to control evaluation order; grouping parentheses can be referenced with $n
引用第 n 个普通括号的结果，编号从左到右；函数括号不编号: Reference the nth grouping parentheses, numbered left to right; function call parentheses are not numbered
计算终值；rate 为每期利率，pv 默认 0，type 默认 0（期末），1: Future value; rate is per period, pv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning; outflows are negative and inflows positive
计算现值；rate 为每期利率，fv 默认 0，type 默认 0（期末），1: Present value; rate is per period, fv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning; outflows are negative and inflows positive
计算每期固定付款额；rate 为每期利率，fv 默认 0，type 默认 0（期: Fixed payment per period; rate is per period, fv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning; positive principal usually produces negative payments
反推付款期数；rate 为每期利率，fv 默认 0，type 默认 0（期末），: Number of payment periods; rate is per period, fv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning; errors when no finite non-negative solution exists
计算指定期的利息部分；per 为从 1 开始的整数，fv 默认 0，type 默: Interest portion for a period; per is an integer starting at 1, fv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning
计算指定期的本金部分；per 为从 1 开始的整数，fv 默认 0，type 默: Principal portion for a period; per is an integer starting at 1, fv defaults to 0, type defaults to 0 (end), 1 means beginning
计算等间隔现金流的净现值；values 为非空数值数组，第一笔在第一期末，当前时: Net present value of periodic cash flows; values is a non-empty numeric array, the first flow is at the end of period 1; add any initial investment at time zero
默认保留字面值与参数精度。开启“空值按 0 处理”后，缺失、未填写或关闭的参数按: Literal and parameter precision is preserved by default. With Null as zero enabled, missing, blank or disabled parameters calculate as zero; invalid input still needs correction.
